projections.source_time_basis: HYCOM instantaneous2022January/July15T00Z;not monthly means or seasonal envelopes.
projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Partial northward eastern Irminger Sea branch along the western Reykjanes Ridge flank, 56–65 N editorial gates. Source describes two cores and intermediate return flow; one local integral maximum is not their summed transport, a uniquely tracked core or a whole-current section. Source also includes deeper northward IC water: a connected velocity contour does not separate upper mode water from deep water masses. Exclude return toward Greenland, North Icelandic continuation, interior gyre circuits, opposite ridge-side current and detached eddies as target identities; broad gates do not independently resolve them.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.

projections.source_time_basis: HYCOM instantaneous2022January/July15T00Z;not monthly means or seasonal envelopes.
projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Partial northward West Spitsbergen slope-current corridor from 73 N editorial Barents-departure approach to 79.6 N pre-branching gate. Exclude upstream Norwegian Atlantic routes, Barents inflow, offshore Front Current feeder, recirculation, shelf/fjord intrusions and downstream Svalbard/Yermak/Yermak Pass branches as target identities. Broad northward maxima do not independently resolve these branches or Atlantic Water membership. Source 1,000 m glider limit is not a current bottom; 20–500 m averaged velocities and source water-mass thresholds are not adopted as model layer boundaries. Spitsbergen Atlantic naming is not merged.
